name: two-clocks
unmodelled: Twin-Wick Incense Clock (enabler): L5 payloads also apply to ticks and the owner's hits deal no damage. Library arts keep their hits (no overrides allowed) and the L5-on-ticks opening is not expressed.
Ash Ledger (identity): 20 % of the tick damage resistance stops burns the target's linh luc. Needs a tick-prevented readable the engine lacks.
Spillover: 25 % of each tick's dealt damage burns linh luc. Not written as an Effect in the old file; left out.
Embers Feed the Hearth: Burn ticks restore 25 % of their dealt damage as linh luc. Not written as an Effect in the old file; left out.
Drain-ward billing of ticks and the ward falling at 0 linh luc (the first clock).
Cinder Debt: cleansed stacks burn the cleanser's linh luc.
Golden Light Shield, Spring Sap, Red/Green Censer and the old Ember Rain/Rot Seed were invented or common arts with no catalogue carrier here; dropped.
Common Ward and Mountain Screen in ward slots (resistance in points, reserved shield). The ward block above is the old pass model.
Purity fire 80 and wood 80 added from the guide (the old file carried none; its c_tick had folded purity in).
